{"id":1912522025,"question_id":4202,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1770561609,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1912522025/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Score Using Exactly K Pairs","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    ll solve(int i, int j, vector<int>& nums1, vector<int>& nums2, int k, vector<vector<vector<ll>>>&dp){\n        // base case\n        if(k==0) return 0;\n        if(i >= nums1.size() || j >= nums2.size()) return -1e18;\n\n        if(dp[i][j][k] != -1e18) return dp[i][j][k];\n\n        ll include , exc1 , exc2 = 0;\n        if(k > 0)\n        {\n            include = (ll)nums1[i]* (ll)nums2[j] + solve(i+1,j+1,nums1,nums2,k-1,dp);\n            exc1 = solve(i+1,j,nums1,nums2,k,dp);\n            exc2 = solve(i,j+1,nums1,nums2,k,dp);\n        }\n        \n        return dp[i][j][k] = max<ll>({include,exc1,exc2});\n    }\n    long long maxScore(vector<int>& nums1, vector<int>& nums2, int k) {\n        vector<vector<vector<ll>>> dp(101,vector<vector<ll>>(101,vector<ll>(k+1,-1e18)));\n        return solve(0,0,nums1,nums2,k,dp);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-score-using-exactly-k-pairs","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1671}
